text: Excellent experience at Dr. Maria's Multi-speciality Dental Clinic. The Dr. is welcoming, and the care provided is top-notch. Truly satisfied with the treatment.
I have got my filling from Dr Maria and I am really impressed by her work. Excellently done. Very happy with her treatment. Painfree and less time taken.

I was there for my RCT in here recently. Dr. Maria walked me through every step before starting, made the whole thing way less scary than I thought it'd be. Pricing was straightforward, no hidden charges or pushing extra treatments. Clinic is clean, equipment looked modern. Will deffo go back.

Dr. Maria's Multi-Speciality Dental Clinic offers exceptional dental care with a focus on patient comfort and advanced treatments. The clinic is well-equipped, ensuring high-quality procedures across various specialties.
Got scaling done here recently, Dr. Maria was gentle and explained everything as she went. Teeth feel so much cleaner now and the price was reasonable, would recommend!

A wonderful experience overall. Dr Maria is very knowledgeable and made sure to explain all the treatment options clearly. I really appreciated her friendly nature. The staff is equally fantastic — polite and efficient.

One of the best dental clinics in Newtown. I recently had a root canal and scaling treatment here, it was a painless experience. Dr. Maria is very humble and professional. I had a good experience here.

I recently had a root canal treatment done by Dr. Maria, and I am highly satisfied with the experience. Dr. Maria demonstrated exceptional skill and professionalism throughout the procedure. The facility was clean. Overall, a positive and pain-free dental experience.
Amazing experience! Had a root canal here and it was painless. The staff is friendly, the clinic is clean, and the dentist is excellent. Highly recommend! 🦷
My first experience at a dental clinic — very well treated and professional. Dr. is very patient and kind, and job well done.
Doctor was quite polite and explained all the procedures. Very professional and the treatment was painless.
Highly recommended. One of the best dental clinics in the Newtown area. Well behaved, highly professional.
Had a good treatment and very friendly dentist.
Very professional and humble doctor. Without any second thought you can visit here. Overall amazing experience!
I went to Kolkata for a trip. During that time I experienced severe gum pain. Doctor advised me scaling. Feeling better after that.
Me and my brother are happy to get good and affordable service. Dentist is kind and friendly.
I had a root canal treatment, I'm very satisfied. Humble doctor.
The whole procedure was painless. Doctor's visit fee is 200/-.
Best place for all oral care at a reasonable price.
Bahut achcha filling lagayen. (Very nice, got a good filling done.)
Best scaling experience. Thanks to doc.
Experienced specialist and updated equipment.
Very good experience and very helpful, thank you so much madam.
RCT koralam. Nice doctor. (Got my RCT done here — nice doctor.)
